title: Webb County Commissioners Share Thanksgiving Greetings
excerpt: Two Webb County commissioners shared Thanksgiving greetings Thursday morning on the county's Facebook page, wishing Laredo families a holiday filled with gratitude, peace, and time with loved ones.
content:
Two Webb County commissioners shared Thanksgiving greetings Thursday morning, Nov. 26, 2026, on the county's Facebook page.

Commissioner Wawi Tijerina of Precinct 2 wished families a wonderful Thanksgiving filled with happiness, peace, and God's abundant blessings, and said we should always be grateful for the blessings we have and the people who make life special. His message also included a verse from the Book of Psalms: “Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good. His love endures forever.”

Commissioner Ricardo A. Jaime of Precinct 4 wished everyone a happy Thanksgiving and a blessed holiday full of joy, gratitude, and the love of family and friends.
